record.paper_title: Steinberg Groups for Jordan Pairs - An Introduction with Open Problems
record.original_question: For more general Jordan pairs V than those covered by Loos's cited theorems, determine whether the same perfectness and simplicity criteria for the projective elementary group PE(V) hold: is PE(V) perfect if and only if V has no simple factors isomorphic to (F_2, F_2), (F_3, F_3), or (H_2(F_2), H_2(F_2)); and is PE(V) simple if and only if V is simple and is not isomorphic to any of those exceptional Jordan pairs?

evidence.quote: In view of the results of [Lo5] it is natural to ask: when is PE(V ) a perfect group, when is it simple?
Thus, the problem is to find out if these two theorems of [Lo5] hold for more general Jordan pairs.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $V = (V^+, V^-)$ be a Jordan pair, and let $L(V)$ denote its Tits–Kantor–Koecher Lie algebra. For $x \in V^\sigma$ ($\sigma = \pm$), let $\exp(x) \in \operatorname{Aut}(L(V))$ be the standard exponential automorphism, and define the projective elementary group
$$PE(V) := \langle \exp(x) : x \in V^+ \cup V^- \rangle \subseteq \operatorname{Aut}(L(V)).$$
A Jordan pair $V$ is called simple if $\{V^+, V^-\} \neq 0$ and $V$ has no nonzero proper ideals. Distinguish the following three "exceptional" simple Jordan pairs: $(\mathbb{F}_2, \mathbb{F}_2)$, $(\mathbb{F}_3, \mathbb{F}_3)$, and $(H_2(\mathbb{F}_2), H_2(\mathbb{F}_2))$, where $H_2(\mathbb{F}_2)$ denotes the Jordan pair of $2 \times 2$ Hermitian matrices over $\mathbb{F}_2$.

Establish, for as general a class of Jordan pairs $V$ as possible (beyond those already handled in the literature, e.g. finite-dimensional simple Jordan pairs over fields, or Jordan pairs covered by Loos's prior theorems):

(a) Is it true that $PE(V)$ is a perfect group if and only if $V$ has no simple direct factor isomorphic to one of $(\mathbb{F}_2, \mathbb{F}_2)$, $(\mathbb{F}_3, \mathbb{F}_3)$, or $(H_2(\mathbb{F}_2), H_2(\mathbb{F}_2))$?

(b) Is it true that $PE(V)$ is a simple group if and only if $V$ is a simple Jordan pair and is not isomorphic to any of $(\mathbb{F}_2, \mathbb{F}_2)$, $(\mathbb{F}_3, \mathbb{F}_3)$, or $(H_2(\mathbb{F}_2), H_2(\mathbb{F}_2))$?
artifact.status_search_result: Loos established perfectness/simplicity criteria for PE(V) when V is a finite-dimensional simple Jordan pair over a field, with exactly the three exceptional cases over F_2 and F_3. The question of extending these criteria to more general (e.g. infinite-dimensional, root-graded, or non-field-based) Jordan pairs is posed as an open problem in subsequent expository work by Loos and Neher; no general resolution appears in the literature found.

status_evidence.title: Steinberg groups and simplicity of elementary groups defined by Jordan pairs
status_evidence.snippet: With exactly 3 exceptions over the Galois fields F2 and F3, the projective elementary group PE(V) is simple.
status_evidence.claim: Loos proved a simplicity theorem for PE(V) for simple Jordan pairs with three exceptions over F_2 and F_3.

status_evidence.title: Steinberg Groups for Jordan Pairs (Loos, Neher)
status_evidence.snippet: PE(V) is defined as the subgroup of Aut(L(V)) generated by exp(V+) and exp(V-).
status_evidence.claim: Defines PE(V) and frames extending perfectness/simplicity to wider classes as an open program.
